result:
The context job holds Main wired, blocking my edit to step3 and marking step1 stale. The cleanest path is to drive through the RUN channel: it waits for the current lock to free (job finishes, Main reverts), re-certifies the stale step1 and done step2, and stops at step3. That resumes me with a clean Main so I can write step3. Going forward I'll run all builds via this channel to avoid the auto-background/lock races.

<<<RUN cwd=LeanEuclidPlus>>>
python3 scripts/check_step.py Book3/Prop25 --drive
<<<END>>>
